name: The Fairly OddParents
description: The zany, fast-paced adventures of a 10-year-old boy and his fairy godparents, who inadvertently create havoc as they grant wishes for their pint-sized charge.

videos.title: Christmas Every Day!
videos.overview: In this special Christmas episode, Timmy wishes everyday was Christmas!  Then, the other holidays get mad at him, and decide to banish Santa to February 33, which doesn't exsist.  Timmy stops them before he gets banished.

videos.title: Abra Catastrophe!
videos.overview: Cosmo and Wanda plan a party to celebrate Timmy having godparents for one year. But Mr. Crocker has other plans that involve a magic muffin that grants one wish without rules to whoever eats it. So Mr. Crocker eats the muffin, so he wishes he can catch a fairy godparent. Crocker gets a butterfly net, and catches Wanda.

videos.title: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour
videos.overview: In this crossover with ""The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius"", Cosmo and Wanda accidentally zap Timmy into the Neutron residence in Retroville while Jimmy finds himself in the Turner's house in Dimmsdale with no clue as to what's going on. Can Timmy's Fairy Godparents fix this mess, or will the two boys be forever stranded in each other's worlds?

videos.title: Channel Chasers
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for a magic remote control that will allow him to travel inside television, despite being grounded and facing pressure from his parents not to watch any. After Vicky wrecks the Turner home while babysitting and blames it on Timmy, they take his magic remote and place it in her hands, unaware of her evil nature and her desire to conquer the world -- a dream she could now make come true unless Timmy, Cosmo, Wanda, and a new friend from the future race through every channel to stop her and her evil scheems.

videos.title: School's Out! The Musical
videos.overview: When it's Summer in Dimmsdale, the kids all look forward to summer vacation, but the parents fear that they are getting too wild. Enter Flappy Bob, who agrees to keep the kids in his day care center all Summer. Timmy quickly remities the situation by wishing kids ruled the world.

videos.title: Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 2: When Nerds Collide
videos.overview: Timmy returns to Retroville, but this time he takes Cosmo and Wanda with him. He and Jimmy fight over who gets to take Cindy to the Friday the 13th dance. Jimmy then returns to Dimmsdale as he takes Carl, Cindy, Sheen, and Libby with him. Meanwhile in Fairy World, the Antifairies escape from their prison again.

videos.title: Fairy Idol
videos.overview: Norm the Genie returns and tricks Cosmo and Wanda into disliking Timmy by replacing him with a selfish, unappreciative clone version. When Cosmo and Wanda quit, a singing contest is held in Fairy World to determine who gets to replace Timmy's godparents.

videos.title: The Jimmy Timmy Power Hour 3: The Jerkinator
videos.overview: Timmy wants to become friends with Jimmy Neutron. While they are friends, they battle each other's enemies, and they create a new villian that they don't like. So they abandon him, but that makes him super evil now, and he takes Cosmo and Wanda's wands and Jimmy's brains. Now it's up to Jimmy and Timmy to solve the problem they got into.

videos.title: Fairly OddBaby
videos.overview:
Fairly OddBaby is a 2008 television film and season premiere of The Fairly OddParents’ sixth season, which first aired on February 18, 2008. The episode was the first to air after a one-year hiatus. The episode received 8.81 million viewers in its initial airing.

The special follows on the series' main character 10-year-old Timmy Turner with Cosmo and Wanda, who are Timmy's fairy godparents and grant his wishes. The special introduces a newborn fairy baby named Poof, who is the child of Cosmo and Wanda and becomes Timmy's fairy godbrother. Poof comes into existence when Cosmo and Wanda decide to have a child of their own, and Timmy wishes it so. However, because the fairy baby's magic is developing and uncontrollable, villains called the anti-fairies and pixies seek to steal the fairy baby so they can take over the fairies' home, Fairy World.

videos.title: Fairly Oddlympics
videos.overview: Timmy gets the fairies, pixies, and anti-fairies to compete in the first Fairy World Games to determine for good and all "who is the best magical creature in the universe." The cheating pixies and anti-fairies, however, make him bet his freedom on the fairies.

videos.title: Merry Wishmas
videos.overview: When Timmy doesn't get what he wants for Christmas he simply wishes for it. However since his friends can't do the same, Timmy wishes every kid could get a magical coupon that would allow them to wish for the one thing they didn't get. But when Vicky gets her hands on one of the magical coupons, her greed throws Christmas all out of balance.

videos.title: Wishology: The Big Beginning
videos.overview: It's up to Timmy to save the universe from the Darkness, a large black hole that could destroy the universe by sucking out all the light and magic in it. Jorgen then sends all the fairies to Earth in order to hide. Timmy then sees some anchient cave drawings that claim that he is the "Chosen" sent to defeat the Darkness by finding three powerful magic wands with the help of Cosmo, Wanda, and Poof, but the Darkness then sends his minions, the Eliminators, to hunt Timmy down throughout the universe to destroy him before he could find those wands.

videos.title: Wishology: The Exciting Middle Part
videos.overview: Timmy learns he merely slowed down The Darkness and now he must seek a second wand to defeat this evil force. Timmy is forced to make amends with his enemies in order to fight for the betterment of mankind.

videos.title: Wishology: The Final Ending
videos.overview: Confident and secure, Timmy feels great after defeating The Darkness as his world turns into a paradise for him; however, he soon discovers that it is all an illusion and that he didn't win, but is now living inside The Darkness. Now his family, his friends, and even his enemies on the outside must rescue him and help him find the third and final wand in order to defeat The Darkness once and for all.

videos.title: Timmy's Secret Wish
videos.overview: Timmy Turner makes his millionth wish which all of Fairy World has gathered to celebrate. But after reviewing his wishes, the Fairy Council finds that Timmy should be put on trial for being the worst godkid ever! Wanda, Cosmo, and Poof think they can prove that Timmy's a good kid, until the truth comes out—Timmy made a secret wish that no one knows about, not even his godfamily.

videos.title: 77 Secrets of the Fairly OddParents Revealed
videos.overview: In this special, 77-ish secrets about Timmy Turner, Cosma, Wanda, and series creator Butch Hartman are revealed. Along with a hint of a new character coming to the show.

videos.title: The Big Problem
videos.overview: Tired of being a kid, Timmy wishes he could be older in order to go adult things, but his wish backfires when "Da Rules" states that now that he is an adult, Cosmo and Wanda can't grant him any wishes or turn him back into a kid until he is a kid or acts like a kid.

videos.title: Power Mad
videos.overview: After wishing for a challenging virtual reality game, Timmy goes to the bathroom and leaves it unattended, and Chester and AJ decide to play. Realizing what has happened, Timmy must go into the game and play to save them.

videos.title: Spaced Out
videos.overview: While watching Crash Nebula, Timmy wishes for an alien to play with. So, Cosmo and Wanda take a real alien prince - Mark. His parents are furious and travel to Earth to blow it up.  In the meantime, Mark has fallen in love with Vicky, and Timmy can't wish him away because GodParents can't interfere with true love. Timmy goes to Mark's parents and asks them to convince their son to forget about Vicky, but Timmy must first pass their toughest tests. Will he be able to fix this mess and save the Earth from destruction?

videos.title: TransParents
videos.overview: After Timmy brings an extinct dinosaur to school, his crazy teacher suspects that he has Fairy GodParents, so he tells Timmy he wants to have a conference with his "parents." Since he has aspirations of "a new world order," he thinks that if he catches fairies, he can harness their power and rule the Earth. Timmy knows he can't explain to his real parents how he managed to come across an extinct dinosaur, so Cosmo and Wanda pose as his parents.

videos.title: A Wish Too Far
videos.overview: Timmy has a giant crush on Trixie Tang, the most popular girl in school, but she doesn't even know he exists. In order to get Trixie to notice him, Timmy wishes for a long list of superficial things to make him popular.

videos.title: Tiny Timmy
videos.overview: Cosmo and Wanda shrink Timmy so he can complete his assignment on the microscopic universe but problems ensue when Cosmo and Wanda, who have also shrunk themselves, get eaten by Vicky. Timmy must now go inside Vicky to save his godparents but stirs up a lot of trouble in the process. To make matters worse, Vicky plans on tearing apart the house and blaming it all on Timmy to his parents.

videos.title: Father Time!
videos.overview: When Timmy breaks his dad's sentimental, grade school trophy and gets punished, he wishes himself back in time to stop his dad (as a kid) from ever winning the dumb thing in the first place.

videos.title: Apartnership
videos.overview: After Wanda gets mad at Cosmo on their umpteenth anniversary, Cosmo visits Fairy World. There, his mom, who has always hated Wanda, announces that she has found him two new girlfriends, Twinkle and Star. In order to get Cosmo back, Wanda must compete against Twinkle and Star in a game show hosted by Cupid, but Cosmo's mom will do anything to ensure that he doesn't go home with Wanda.

videos.title: Chin Up
videos.overview: Timmy meets his favorite superhero, The Crimson Chin, but the discovery that he is fictional sends the hero into a deep depression. Timmy must now reverse this situation, and as a result, he gains the superhero alter-ego of Cleft the Boy Chin Wonder.

videos.title: Dog's Day Afternoon
videos.overview: Timmy switches lives with Vicky's dog, but swiftly discovers that the dog actually has it just as badly as he does.

videos.title: Dream Goat
videos.overview: When Timmy feels sorry for the town's caged, prize goat, Chompy, and wishes he could be free, the goat disappears and Vicky gets blamed for goat-napping.

videos.title: The Same Game
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for everyone in the world to be the same when an evil dentist won't give him his ball back. Problems inevitably ensue, and Timmy can't wish things back to normal as Cosmo and Wanda aren't able figure out who he is.

videos.title: Boys in the Band
videos.overview: Vicky has kidnapped teen singing sensation Chip Skylark. A stadium full of screaming girls (and Mrs. Turner) are going to tear the town apart if he doesn't perform for them.

videos.title: Hex Games
videos.overview: Timmy tries to beat Vicky at a skateboarding contest so he can become queen (eh, king) of the skate park.

videos.title: Boy Toy
videos.overview: Hoping for one last adventure with his Crimson Chin action figure, Timmy wishes to be doll-sized.

videos.title: Inspection Detection
videos.overview: Thanks to all the stuff he's gotten from his fairies, Timmy's parents suspect that he's a shoplifter. On the same day, Cosmo and Wanda have an inspection day with Jorgen Von Strangle. Timmy must prove his innocence while his godparents prove their competence or they'll never see each other again.

videos.title: Action Packed
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that his entire life was like an action movie,  but things quickly turn to chaos when all of his loved ones are put in danger.

videos.title: Smarty Pants
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that he knew everything in the world so he can beat A-student A.J. at the Brain-A-Thon.

videos.title: Timvisible
videos.overview: Timmy's shot at the perfect attendance award is threatened by bully Francis. Timmy wishes to become invisible, but soon, everyone believes the school is haunted. That is, except Crocker, who knows that catching Timmy will be all the evidence he needs to prove the existence of Fairies.

videos.title: That Old Black Magic
videos.overview: Timmy goes to an amusement park in Friday the 13th and he figures that something is destroying the park, until Cosmo and Wanda give him special glasses to see the Anti-Fairies who are causing the problem.

videos.title: Super Bike
videos.overview: For the annual Father-Son bike race, Timmy wishes up a bike that's unstoppable, unbreakable, and totally modern and cool: Super Bike. But the bike gets super jealous of Timmy's friends and hobbies.

videos.title: A Mile In My Shoes
videos.overview: Timmy thinks Cosmo and Wanda have it easy being godparents, and vice versa. To prove each other's points, Timmy becomes a fairy and Cosmo and Wanda become normal kids. But Timmy can't control his magic and has to undergo training from Jorgen von Strangle, and Cosmo and Wanda have a tough time dealing with Timmy's parents and school.

videos.title: Foul Balled
videos.overview: When Timmy asks his fairies to use their magic to make Chester the “best baseball player” ever, things go from bad, to great, to worse.

videos.title: The Boy Who Would Be Queen
videos.overview: Timmy tells Trixie Tang that he has a great gift for her, so he can be invited to her party. Obviously, he's lying. Later that day, Timmy and Cosmo start making of girls, and Wanda becomes so angry she turns Timmy into a girl. Timmy decides being a girl can help him/her figure out what Trixie would like for her birthday, so he/she goes off to the mall...but not without revenge on his godparents for turning him into a girl...he wishes Cosmo was a woman and Wanda was a man.

videos.title: Totally Spaced Out
videos.overview: When Timmy vaguely wishes that Vicky was a million, million miles from him, she ends up being brought to the War planet of Yugopatamia, and lands in the love-struck tentacles of Mark Chang, alien prince!

videos.title: The Switch Glitch
videos.overview: Timmy is angry with Vicky, as the babysitter always gets her way, so he wishes he could be her babysitter so he can get revenge. He eventually grows guilty, and things get worse when Cosmo and Wanda get reassigned to Vicky!

videos.title: Mighty Mom and Dyno Dad
videos.overview: Timmy, sick of his parents rushing to work and coming home late, tired, and never having any time for him, wishes that they had superpowers.

videos.title: Knighty Knight
videos.overview: After being ripped off by the Camelot Fair, Timmy wishes he was in the real Camelot, but Timmy's parents somehow come along with him and are about to be eaten by a dragon!

videos.title: Fairy Fairy Quite Contrary
videos.overview: Timmy becomes suspicious of a rich boy named Remy when he notices that he can be better than him in many situations. Timmy eventually learns that he has a fairy godparent.

videos.title: Nectar of The Odds
videos.overview: Timmy needs to raise money for tickets to see Crash Nebula on Ice, so he starts a lemonade stand. But his lemonade tastes terrible! That's when Cosmo, stupidly, puts his sweaty socks into a glass. Believe it or not, it makes the lemonade taste a lot better. But it also starts granting everyone's wishes!

videos.title: Hail to the Chief
videos.overview: Timmy decides to run for Student Body President to capture the attention and affection of the lovely, popular Trixie Tang.

videos.title: Twistory
videos.overview: Timmy wishes the great American leaders into his treehouse talk show to finish his report, but because they have vanished from history, the United States reverts to being a British colony and Timmy must find a way to get them back.

videos.title: Fool's Day Out
videos.overview: Timmy is pranked by his parents and fairies on Fourth of July. In retaliation, Timmy summons the April Fool, who does very dangerous pranks.

videos.title: Deja Vu
videos.overview: Timmy is always stressed out at the end of the day, with being beat up by Francis, failing grades, and Vicky!  So he decides to have a reset watch so he can turn back time and redo things. But when Vicky gets hold of the watch, who only knows what will happen next!

videos.title: Scary Godparents
videos.overview: During his worst Halloween ever, Timmy wishes that everyone's Halloween costumes were real and scary.

videos.title: Ruled Out
videos.overview: Tired of having strict parents, Timmy wishes for care-free parents.

videos.title: That's Life
videos.overview: Timmy's mother is desperately trying to win the annual Dimmsdale Veg-Out, but her garden looks more like a barren desert. To help his mom, Timmy wishes that her garden was "full of life."

videos.title: Shiny Teeth
videos.overview: An evil Dentist steals teen pop singer Chip Skylark's teeth and only one person can stop him: The Tooth Fairy.

videos.title: Odd Odd West
videos.overview: Timmy travels back in time to the Old West to find the lost deed for Dimmsdale Flats.

videos.title: Cosmo Con
videos.overview: Cosmo is chosen to hold the notoriously short Fairy Convention. But things go haywire when he decides to hold it in Timmy's bathroom, especially while they're having Mr. Crocker over for dinner!

videos.title: Wanda's Day Off
videos.overview: Wanda's been working so hard, the boys give her a day off. Cosmo promises not to grant any wishes, to keep chaos at a minimum. But when Timmy has trouble doing his animal report, Cosmo messes things up big time!

videos.title: Information Stupor Highway
videos.overview: Timmy is writing a e-mail to Trixie, about the school dance, but Timmy's parents come in and make the e-mail all about love, and they send it! So Timmy transforms into computer data to try to retrieve the letter before it reaches Trixie.

videos.title: Odd Jobs
videos.overview: Cosmo and Wanda create a magical website that gives Mr. Turner new jobs.

videos.title: Movie Magic
videos.overview: Timmy wants to impress Trixie Tang with a film, but Tad and Chad have produced their own big-budget film starring actual actors. Although Timmy knows he can't use his fairies to win the competition, there is nothing against Da Rules that says he can't film actual historical events as part of his movie.

videos.title: Love Struck!
videos.overview: Timmy learns from Cupid that Tootie is destined to be his special someone, but he doesn't want to waste his first kiss on Vicky's little sister instead of Trixie, so he creates an elaborate Valentine for Trixie consisting of dancers and a song. After Trixie rejects him yet again, Timmy decides to wish all girls to another part of the world before Tootie can get to him.

videos.title: Most Wanted Wish
videos.overview: After every wimpy kid in the school was picked over him by Tad and Chad, and Trixie chose a rock over him as her lab partner, Timmy wishes that he was the most wanted kid on Earth.

videos.title: This is Your Wish
videos.overview: Cosmo's overbearing mother, Mama Cosma, makes another attempt at prying him away from Wanda and Timmy by luring them onto a game show called "This is Your Wish" hosted by Billy Crystal Ball.

videos.title: Engine Blocked
videos.overview: Mr. Turner is going through mid-life crisis and impulsively buys a sports car from Vicky. Timmy wishes that he was car so he could spend time with his dad.

videos.title: The Crimson Chin Meets Mighty Mom and Dyno Dad!
videos.overview: Timmy accidentally wishes Nega-Chin out of a comic book and allows Cosmo and Wanda to grant his wishes.

videos.title: Sleepover And Over
videos.overview: Timmy's friends, A.J. and Chester argue and break their friendship. When they each invite him to their respective sleepovers on the same night, to watch a Crash Nebula/Crimson Chin crossover special, this creates a problem for Timmy. How will he join both of them without being discovered? How will he reunite his friends?

videos.title: Mother Nature
videos.overview: Mrs. Turner wins a contest that makes her the new weather-person of the local news, and Timmy wishes that everything she will predict would come true.

videos.title: Beddy Bye
videos.overview: Being annoyed by his inability to stay up all night and thus missing night-time events, Timmy wishes for the world to have no sleep at all. He soon realizes that everyone needs sleep to function.

videos.title: The Grass Is Always Greener
videos.overview: After overhearing an out of context conversation by his parents where they'd wish that they were more like Mr. Dinkleberg and without any children, Timmy gets upset and decides to fulfill their wish by running away from home.

videos.title: The Secret Origin of Denzel Crocker
videos.overview: March 15 is the day that every child fears - the day where Mr. Crocker is at his meanest, and the reason of his extreme unhappiness remain a mystery, so Timmy uses the Time Scooter to go back to Crocker's childhood to solve it. Timmy finds a shocking secret that involves Crocker and fairies.

videos.title: So Totally Spaced Out
videos.overview: After cute and cuddly creatures named "Gigglepies" invade and capture Yugopotamia, Mark Prince flees his planet to enlist the help of the "mighty Earth warrior" Timmy Turner in defeating the threat.

videos.title: MicroPhony
videos.overview: It's summer time and all the parents are leaving their children under Vicky's slave care, so Timmy decides to use his treehouse as a radio station to broadcast a message to all the parents in Dimmsdale: To spend time with their kids in the summer.

videos.title: The Big Scoop!
videos.overview: Chester and A.J. decide to dig up some dirt on their friend, who has inexplicably joined the popular clique after a sudden disappearance of his parents.

videos.title: Pipe Down!
videos.overview: After failing to complete his block version of the Eiffel Tower and after getting yelled at several times, Timmy wishes that everything was completely silent, but problems arise when a meteor is heading for Earth and Timmy can't wish it gone!!!! Will Timmy save all sound?

videos.title: Crime Wave
videos.overview: Timmy wants to get a new Crimson Chin comic while bathing, so he wishes himself there, but appears in the nude and must run all the way back home naked. Meanwhile, inside the comic book Timmy left behind, the Crimson Chin fights H20lga!

videos.title: Odd Ball
videos.overview: After Timmy's V-Cube burns out due to him selfishly overplaying it, his parents refuse to buy him a new one and Timmy is forced to get a job by playing on the local basketball team, the Dimmsdale Ballhogs.

videos.title: Where's Wanda?
videos.overview: After Timmy wins a student motion picture fair at his school in a stunning upset with his goldfish costumed as Jaws, Wanda mysteriously disappears after a brief power outage, and it's up to Timmy and Cosmo to solve the mystery.

videos.title: Imaginary Gary
videos.overview: After his parents ignore him yet again, Timmy remembers his imaginary friend he made up in his youth, Gary, and decides to wish him real.

videos.title: Miss Dimmsdale
videos.overview: Timmy tries to keep Vicky from cheating in the Miss Dimmsdale beatuy contest.

videos.title: Mind Over Magic
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that he could read minds.

videos.title: Kung Timmy
videos.overview: Francis beats up Timmy again, and after Mr. Turner tries to intervene, he gets beaten up too, resulting in the bully taking the Turner's own house and car. After briefly training in kung-fu, Timmy decides fight Francis.

videos.title: Which Witch Is Which?
videos.overview: Who really founded Dimmsdale? Timmy goes back in time to Colonial Dimmsdale to meet the legendary Dale Dimm, and almost gets burned at the stake in the process.

videos.title: Hard Copy
videos.overview: While Wanda takes a terrifed Cosmo to the doctor, she leaves Timmy with a magic photo copier that can make copies of anything. He then makes a life-size Darth Vader action figure that tries to destroy Dimmsdale.

videos.title: Parent Hoods
videos.overview: Timmy's parents are mistaken for wanted outlaws, and Timmy tries to catch the real crooks.

videos.title: Chip Off the Old Chip
videos.overview: To win the lead role in the school musical with Trixie Tang, Timmy wishes that he had Chip Skylark's voice.

videos.title: Snow Bound
videos.overview: Timmy's dad thinks mom is in danger from an abominable snowman so he rushes up to mount Dimmsdale...

videos.title: The Big Superhero Wish
videos.overview: In another case of ""Be careful what you wish for,"" Timmy wishes the world was more like a Crimson Chin comic book, and Cosmo and Wanda turn him and all his friends into superheroes!

videos.title: Vicky Loses Her Icky
videos.overview: Have you ever wondered what makes Vicky so mean? The answer is surprisingly easy: She has a bug up her butt.When timmy wishes that his mean and nasty babysitter   would be nice, a magical bug containing Vicky's evil essence crawls crawls from out of her butt leaving behind a sweet and docile teenager. Vicky is now a total saint. But the evil   Has to go somewhere, which means that   the bug is on the hunt for its next host.

videos.title: Pixies Inc.
videos.overview: Pixies have bought fairy world! Under the new management of the monotonous and very corporate Pixies, everyone's wishes are being denied. So Timmy challenges the head pixie to a winner-takes-all game of miniature golf:   If Timmy wins, the pixies will leave fairy world, but if he loses, Cosmo and Wanda will have to leave Timmy forever.

videos.title: Baby Face
videos.overview: Now that Timmy's old enough, he doesn't have to be subjected to all the kiddie stuff at Flappy Bob's Happy Learnatorium anymore.

videos.title: Mr. Right
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that everything he said was right, and he gets exactly what he asked for.

videos.title: Power Pals
videos.overview: Timmy decides to wish for a group of superheroes to be his new friends

videos.title: Emotion Commotion
videos.overview: After being embarrassed in public, Timmy wishes he has no emotions and ends up working for the CIA.

videos.title: Lights... Camera... Adam!
videos.overview: Timmy is an stunt-boy in the Crimson Chin movie where he uncovers a plot to discredit the Chin.

videos.title: A Bad Case of Diary-Uh
videos.overview: Timmy gets a hold of Vicky's diary and uses her deepest secrets to try to get revenge against her.

videos.title: Odd Couple
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for a perfect match for Vicky, and soon Ricky and Vicky fall in love with each other.

videos.title: Class Clown
videos.overview: Timmy tries to win the heart of his one true love by wishing that he was the funniest guy on Earth.

videos.title: Who's Your Daddy?
videos.overview: It's time for the Father-Son Squirrely Scout competition, but Dad gets called away for work, leaving Timmy without a partner.

videos.title: Homewrecker
videos.overview: Timmy is sick of Vicky messing up his house then blaming it on him, so Timmy gets his revenge on Vicky by doing the same.

videos.title: Crash Nebula
videos.overview: Sprig Speevak is leaving his parent's farm for an intergalactic academy where he will learn to be a space hero. But first, he has to learn to survive space high school.

videos.title: Shelf Life
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that Tom Sawyer could come out of his book and help him with his book report.

videos.title: Fairy Friends and Neighbors
videos.overview: When Jimmy wishes for friends to hang out with his folks, Cosmo and Wanda are the ones who get stuck with the job.

videos.title: Just The Two of Us
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that he and Trixie were the only people on the planet.

videos.title: New Squid in Town
videos.overview: Mark Chang is on the run from his enraged bride-to-be whom he left at the altar. He looks to the only Earthling who can help, Timmy Turner.

videos.title: Wish Fixers
videos.overview: Timmy is ordered to undergo a program that will teach him to make harmless wishes.

videos.title: Genie Meanie Minie Moe
videos.overview: Timmy accidentally releases a genie from a magic lava lamp.

videos.title: Teeth for Two
videos.overview: Jorgen has to stay with Cosmo and Wanda after the Tooth Fairy thinks he was doing her job (He was actually attempting to remove Timmy's teeth- allegedly the 'dental equivalent of the Hope Diamond'- to use as an engagement ring for her).

videos.title: Nega-Timmy
videos.overview: Timmy wishes to do the opposite of what his parents tell him to, and when they say be good, he turns evil.

videos.title: Love at First Height
videos.overview: Timmy becomes 16 to ride a rollercoaster and Vicky accidentally falls in love with him and everybody want's to be with Timmy believing that he's a Norwegian super model.

videos.title: Truth or Cosmoquences
videos.overview: Cosmo and Wanda receive invitations to their high school reunion.

videos.title: Beach Bummed
videos.overview: After some ritual beach-themed bullying, courtesy of Francis, Timmy wishes that he was the strongest guy on the beach.

videos.title: Just Desserts
videos.overview: Timmy's wish for a world of desserts could mean an early end for everyone.

videos.title: You Doo!
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for a You-Doo doll of Francis for revenge. Later on, Timmy gets You-Doo dolls of mostly every main character on the show. Tootie gets the You-Doo of Timmy, and the trouble starts!

videos.title: Catman Meets The Crimson Chin
videos.overview: When Catman becomes depressed because no one in Dimmsdale appreciates his brand of cat-themed justice, Timmy wishes him into the world of the Crimson Chin.

videos.title: Back To Norm
videos.overview: Mr. Crocker receives the magic lava lamp as a present and tries to capture Timmy's fairies in a Roadrunner-like manner

videos.title: The Masked Magician
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for Magician powers to attract everyone to his parents yard, but this has unintended consequences.

videos.title: The Big Bash
videos.overview: Timmy and Remy get in a hunt, and the winner gets a few rule-free wishes. If Remy wins, Timmy will lose his godparents, and Wandisimo gets Wanda.

videos.title: Blondas Have More Fun
videos.overview: Wanda pays a visit to her successful twin sister Blonda. The sisters spiral into bickering with each one convinced the other has a much easier life.

videos.title: Five Days Of Flarg
videos.overview: Mark the alien is missing Flarg on his planet so he has it on Earth.

videos.title: Go Young, West Man
videos.overview: TV's Adam West, star of the superhero series "Catman," never had a real childhood. Timmy wishes that Adam could become a kid again.

videos.title: Birthday Wish
videos.overview: Timmy loans his godparents to Tootie on her birthday to make up for a lousy one.

videos.title: Timmy's 2-D House of Horror
videos.overview: Timmy turns a boring 3-D movie volcano into a real volcano but it destroys Vicky's house and her and her family have to live with Timmy, now he must drive them out.

videos.title: It's A Wishful Life
videos.overview: Unappreciated by his parents, his friends and Fairy Godparents, Timmy wishes that he was never born, but he soons learns maybe everyone's life is better out without him.

videos.title: Escape From Unwish Island
videos.overview: Everyone Timmy cares about has vanished. He soon finds all his old rejected wishes have come back for revenge.

videos.title: The Grand Plan
videos.overview: Cosmo's Fagiggligland (what fairies use to transform into diffrent things) isn't working and might loose his job being Timmy's godparent. The gang must get Anti-Cosmo out of Anti-fairy jail in order to do a transplant performed by Dr. Rip Studwell. But Jorgen Vonstrangle won't let them through or let Anti-Cosmo out!

videos.title: Hassle in the Castle
videos.overview: Timmy snoops inside his fairies fishbowl castle, but causes trouble after accidentally wishing back past godkids in the Hall of Infamy.

videos.title: Remy Rides Again
videos.overview: Remy returns and has a diabolical plan to get Timmy to become his friend and spend more time with him, just so he could get rid of his godparents.

videos.title: Talkin' Trash
videos.overview: Wanda's father and Timmy must clean up magical garbage in Timmy's house.

videos.title: Timmy TV
videos.overview: Timmy has become the unknowing subject of Fairy World's most popular Reality TV series, "Timmy TV."

videos.title: Mooooving Day
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that his Mom could sell a house to anyone. With her new found success they manage to move into a new neighborhood.

videos.title: Big Wanda
videos.overview: Someone’s kidnapped Big Daddy! With the big mob boss missing, Wanda is called in to run the family business. Her first task: a mafia makeover complete with pink trash removal uniforms, pink garbage trucks, and doilies on all the fairy world trash cans.

videos.title: Oh, Brother
videos.overview: Life would be better with an older brother. At least that's what Timmy believes.

videos.title: What's the Difference?
videos.overview: Timmy's reading a find-it book when Mark Chang, in his traditional alien form, shows up. His changer is broken, and without it, Mandie will find him. In a last ditch effort to save Mark, Timmy wishes the school was like his book. But she is about to turn the school into a crater if Mark doesn’t show himself. If Cosmo and Wanda had their wands, Timmy could just wish her away. But where are the wands hiding?

videos.title: Smart Attack
videos.overview: Dad keeps trying to help Timmy with his homework. But he’s not the brightest dad, so any help he gives does more harm than good. How can Timmy get his dad to stop helping without hurting his feelings? He doesn’t. He completely avoids the subject by wishing that his dad was smart. Now that Dad has the brains of a genius, he home-school’s Timmy and pays a lot more attention to things like Timmy’s goldfish. In all the years that Timmy has had his pet fish, not once has he fed them. Dad concludes that they must be a new breed and sets out to dissect the fish in front of the entire scientific community.

videos.title: Operation FUN
videos.overview: Remy Buxaplenty has come home from military school for spring break. All he can talk about is how great his new school is, making Timmy, Chester, and AJ very jealous in the process. Timmy decides they should all get to go to Remy’s fancy academy and wishes for three scholarships. Once the boys get to their new school, they find that it is not quite the paradise Remy described -- it’s the exact opposite. The students have to get up before dawn every morning, all the teachers are drill sergeants, and pets are strictly forbidden which means that Timmy’s pet goldfish (a.k.a. Cosmo and Wanda) are confiscated and placed in storage. This of course was Remy’s plan all along, and now that Timmy can’t get to his God Parents, he cannot wish himself out of this nightmare.

videos.title: Something's Fishy
videos.overview: Timmy is at the beach and he’s bored silly. He, Cosmo, and Wanda set off to explore the deep, and everywhere they go, but Cosmo seems to be hated by every single fish. Soon, they end up in the lost city of Atlantis. Timmy appeals to Atlantis’ leader, King Greg -- if he can show good cause why Atlanteans should be happy beneath the sea, Cosmo will be set free. Will Timmy save Cosmo?

videos.title: Presto Change-O
videos.overview: Timmy hasn’t studied for a test in Mr. Crocker’s class, so he wishes for a magical device that allows him to change places with anyone who comes in contact with it. Cosmo and Wanda are in a hurry, so they give Timmy his wish. At school, he uses this device to change places with AJ, but after that, his plan backfires. Will Timmy be able to stop Crocker from finding out about Timmy's fairies? Find out.

videos.title: The Good Ol' Days
videos.overview: Timmy's got a break from Vicky; unfortunately, he's being babysat by Dad's Dad, Pappy. However Pappy doesn't like any of Timmy's modern entertainment.

videos.title: Future Lost
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for his society to be more futuristic, like a fictional character from one of Dad's old books. However, this society is filled with robots, who are seemingly harmless, but in reality, are evil. Will Timmy escape from this dreaded society?

videos.title: Timmy The Barbarian
videos.overview: Binky's sick, so Jorgen shows up with some soup and a bedtime story to make him feel better. The story is "Timmy the Barbarian," and as Jorgen tells it to Binky, poor Timmy, Cosmo and Wanda find themselves actually living it!

videos.title: No Substitute for Crazy
videos.overview: Crocker has fallen into a well and so Timmy's class has been assigned a substitute teacher called Mrs. Sunshine and she seems very-very nice until Timmy wishes for her to be his permanent teacher, she turns out to be even worse than Mr. Crocker when she is really an expert fairy hunter named Mrs. Doombringer.

videos.title: Mission Responsible
videos.overview: Timmy offers to baby-sit Poof for Cosmo and Wanda so they can have the night out.

videos.title: Hairicane
videos.overview: Sick and tired of his father's bad haircuts, Timmy wishes for indestructible hair with a personality that can't be cut. It then comes to life as it grows and almost destroys Dimmsdale. Meanwhile, Wanda takes Poof to the baby fairy barber shop for his first haircut.

videos.title: Open Wide And Say Aaagh!
videos.overview: Timmy's got to have his tonsils out and Vicky is determined to make his stay in the hospital as painful as possible!

videos.title: Odd Pirates
videos.overview: The Pirates opening game is today, and everyone except Timmy is going. Timmy wishes he was at the game, but when Wanda lets Poof make the wish, they end up on a real Pirate ship. The wands get stolen, they get trapped in a net, and almost get attacked by crocodiles. When Timmy opens his big mouth, the pirate ship becomes land-born. The pirates attack the Pirates games, and the Pirates baseball team helps defeat them.

videos.title: The Odd Squad
videos.overview: Timmy wishes Cosmo was a talking car so that he and his fairies can search for the missing Mama Cosma.

videos.title: For Emergencies Only
videos.overview: Feeling that Cosmo and Wanda are neglecting him for Poof, Timmy gets his godparents to give him his own magic wand with ten wishes on it.

videos.title: Cheese & Crockers
videos.overview: On Happy Half Day where "half-ness" is celebrated, Timmy wishes for a machine that lets him become half-Timmy/ half-whatever, but it also turns Mr. Crocker into a cheese powered megalomaniac.

videos.title: The Land Before Timmy
videos.overview: Sick of technology ruining his life, Timmy wishes to live in a simpler time. He and all of Dimmsdale are then sent to the Stone Age.

videos.title: King Chang
videos.overview: Mark Chang is called back to the planet Yugopotamia to become King when Princess Mandie sizes the throne from his father, and Timmy has to get help from Vicky to save Mark and his people.

videos.title: The End of the Universe-ity
videos.overview: Dark Laser's back and after trying (and failing) to destroy Timmy, he adopts the saying, "if you can't beat 'em, get 'em to join you." He offers Timmy a scholarship to "Dark-Mouth University" in an effort to get him to become his evil apprentice. Timmy refuses but Mom and Dad – excited that someone else is going to pay for Timmy's college – eagerly accept the offer. Timmy is given a dark suit with dark powers and the proviso that if Timmy tries it and doesn't want it, Dark Laser will leave Earth alone forever. Timmy agrees, and soon it seems he's fallen under the evil spell of the evil suit.

videos.title: Sooper Poof
videos.overview: Poof is trying to get the hang of shape shifting but unfortunately he takes after Cosmo! And worse, one of his attempts has him crash landing in front of the Turner house, where Mom and Dad find him and become convinced he's an alien super baby they need to raise to fight for truth and justice! But Timmy can't just steal Poof back because Mom and Dad have fallen in love with the little guy, so he must devise another way of getting Poof back to Cosmo and Wanda before Dad's attempts to turn the baby into a super hero get them all in trouble!

videos.title: Wishing Well
videos.overview: Timmy's been running Cosmo and Wanda ragged so Jorgen takes him to "Wishing Well", a state of the art rehabilitation facility where he can learn to wish less and be more independent. He meets two other kids with fairies and together they battle their darkest fears, escape from precarious situations…and make breakfast, all without wishing. In the end, they learn independence only when they band together to escape, which they do without any fairy assistance whatsoever. But escaping wasn't part of Jorgen's plan…or was it? Either way, it worked!

videos.title: Wishy Washy
videos.overview: Timmy's wish for a magical car wash that rejuvenates anything that goes through it so his father can restore his beloved Striker Z sports car, but fossils of dinosuars and cavemen also go through it causing them to come back to life and run amok in Dimmsdale, as do Cosmo and Wanda, turning them into rebellious teenagers.

videos.title: Poof's Playdate
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for some fairy babies to play with lonely Poof, turning Cosmo, Wanda, Jorgen, the Tooth Fairy, Juandisimo, and Cupid into fairy babies.

videos.title: Vicky Gets Fired
videos.overview: Despite all the ways Vicky has tortured Timmy, it's only when she accidentally erases a videotape that Mom and Dad actually fire her. Determined to get a job, Vicky decides she wants to be mayor and takes over the city. As she's ready to make Vickyville a whole new country, Timmy, who's happy for the first time, realizes he's got to get Vicky out of office and back as his babysitter in order to maintain peace.

videos.title: Chinred Spirits
videos.overview: Timmy's disappointed to see how boring the Crimson Chin comics have become lately. When he spends a day with the Chin, he sees why - the Chin is lonely. Timmy wishes up a super girlfriend for him, except now the comic is both boring and romantic, yuck! Desperate, Timmy unknowingly makes a wish that changes everything, so he must undo his wish - and fast.

videos.title: 9 Lives
videos.overview: Binky is ill so Jorgen comes to cheer him up by telling him a magical story about Timmy Cosmo and Wanda, but this is bad news for the trio as what ever Jorgen says will happen in the story. This will be tricky for the two heroes and pack mule.

videos.title: Dread & Breakfast
videos.overview: Dad's quit his job to make sock monkeys, and there's no income for the Turners...until Mom turns the house into a bed and breakfast. That'd be fine, if the first guests weren't Mr. Crocker, Dark Laser and Tootie who either want to destroy Timmy or kiss him. As Timmy runs around frantically trying to stay one step ahead of his house guests, he must find a way to get everyone out without using the very fairy magic Crocker is hoping to catch him using.

videos.title: Bad Heir Day
videos.overview: Crocker gets a hold of Poof and decides to groom him to be the heir to his "fame and fortune."

videos.title: Freaks and Greeks
videos.overview: When Timmy's parents go to a toga party, his fairies take him to one on Mount Olympus where he accidentily destroys it with a thunderbolt, so the gods move the party to his house.

videos.title: Mice-Capades
videos.overview: When Poof watches too much of the violent classic "cat and mouse" cartoon, "Cheesy and Sleazy", he turns Timmy and Vicky into the characters from the show.

videos.title: Formula For Disaster
videos.overview: Poof's refusal to take his medicine and Crocker's visit to the Turner residence to complain about Timmy's bad grades leads to chaos in the Turner household.

videos.title: Birthday Bashed
videos.overview: Timmy looks forward to his birthday until Jorgen reminds him that each birthday draws him a year closer to losing his fairies; however, Timmy isn't worried because his folks always forget his birthday, but he then panics when they seem to remember it this time.

videos.title: Momnipresent
videos.overview: Timmy's preperations for the party of the year are interrupted by his mother who wants to spend some quality time with him. He then sneaks away every chance he gets to get the party ready.

videos.title: Anti-Poof
videos.overview: When Poof's anti-fairy counterpart, Foop, is born, it is up to Poof to save his loved ones and Fairy World from him.

videos.title: Squirrely Puffs
videos.overview: It's a race between the Squirrely Scouts and the Cream Puffs to the top of Mount Doom. Will Timmy's team survive this harrowing challenge, or will Mom and the "girls" make them turn tail?

videos.title: Add-a-Dad
videos.overview: Timmy's dad is very busy working, so busy in fact, that when Timmy & him are doing something fun, he suddenly has to leave & Timmy's left alone. So he finds a solution, to wish up many dads, so that every time one of them has to leave, he has another one, but then there's too many dads! And they all want Timmy! Then when he realizes he doesn't want or need many dads, he has to find a way to get rid of them.......by sending them to another planet and gives them Timmy plushies so they can be happy!

videos.title: Fly Boy
videos.overview: Everybody in Dimmsdale is watching the latest horror film, "Fly Boy". But Timmy isn't allowed to, so when he wishes to become a "fly on the wall" in order to see it, the real horror begins.

videos.title: Temporary Fairy
videos.overview: Jorgen serves as over-adventurious Timmy's temproary godparent when Cosmo and Wanda become too busy with Poof.

videos.title: Crocker Shocker
videos.overview: Fairy World's magic is shut down when Mr. Crocker is hypnotized into no longer believing in fairies.

videos.title: Super Zero
videos.overview: When Cosmo gets ousted from the house for being too annoying, he then becomes Dimmdale's newest superhero.

videos.title: Dadracadabra
videos.overview: Mr. Crocker suspects that Timmy's Dad is a fairy when Timmy and his fairies help him with his magic

videos.title: Timmy Turnip
videos.overview: Timmy meets his grandparents and quickly wishes they never came to America. He finds himself back in Ustinkistan, his grandparents' native country, and he must somehow get on the next boat home.

videos.title: One Man Banned
videos.overview: After Timmy is rejected from the school band, he wishes everyone would love his music. But when Timmy gets his first taste of acclaim, Wanda has to stop him before he becomes completely fame-crazy.

videos.title: Frenemy Mine
videos.overview: Vicky becomes Timmy's friend after he saves her life.

videos.title: Double Oh Schnozmo
videos.overview: Cosmo's brother, Schnozmo, comes to visit, claiming to be a secret agent But when he turns out to be nothing but a con man, Wanda makes him take part in a real spy adventure to spare Cosmo's feelings.

videos.title: Planet Poof
videos.overview: Feeling ignored by his family,Poof runs away to Yugopotamia where the unappreciated Queen uses his cuteness to scare the residents into giving her whatever she wants.

videos.title: The Boss Of Me
videos.overview: When Timmy goes to visit his father's office, he wishes up a pencil that will last forever. This impresses Dad's boss so much that he hires Timmy and orders him to fire Dad.

videos.title: He Poofs, He Scores
videos.overview: Timmy tries out for the soccer team his father coaches, the Victims. He accidently swallows Poof, however, who goes right to his brain and makes him the greatest soccer player ever.

videos.title: Play Date of Doom
videos.overview: Foop escapes from prison seeking revenge on Poof.

videos.title: Teacher's Pet
videos.overview: When Timmy wishes that he was the teacher's pet, Poof turns him into Mr. Crocker's guinea pig.

videos.title: Chicken Poofs
videos.overview: Poof has the contageous Chicken Poofs disease that turns him into a chicken, and everyone he sneazes on turns into chickens as well. He then flees from the hospital, and Timmy and Cosmo try to catch him before he infects all of Dimmsdale while Wanda and Dr. Rip Studwell search for a cure.

videos.title: Stupid Cupid
videos.overview: Timmy seeks help from Cupid to win the love of Trixie Tang, but Cupid is on vacation. So Timmy has Cosmo fill in for the love god, but Cosmo only causes himself, Wanda, Mr. and Mrs. Turner, and Mr. Crocker to fall head over heals in love with all sorts of things.

videos.title: Manic Mom Day
videos.overview: When Timmy envies his mother's life, Wanda makes makes them swap bodies for a day on a bet that if Timmy finds a mother's life easier, Wanda will have to spend a week as a chicken; otherwise, Timmy will have to go a week without magic.

videos.title: Crocker of Gold
videos.overview: Crocker captures Cosmo, mistaking him for a leperchaun, and Cosmo then steals a pot of gold from a clan of real leperchauns to buy his freedom. The clan then holds Wanda and Poof hostage until Cosmo and Timmy replace it.

videos.title: Love Triangle
videos.overview: Poof is upset his parents want him to take the lead role in the school play, but he quickly changes his mind after his new crush, Goldie Goldenglow gets the female lead role, but to get the role, he has to beat his archnemesis Foop, who also fell for Goldie.

videos.title: Spellementery School
videos.overview: With Poof's first day in Spellementary School, he and Foop compete to be the most popular student there, but Foop takes it to extremes when his classmates don't accept him, and its up to Poof to stop his anti-fairy counterpart from tearing apart the school!

videos.title: Operation Dinkelberg
videos.overview: Timmy's Dad becomes obsessed with proving his neighbor, Mr. Dinkleberg is evil. He enlists Timmy to help him spy on Dinkleberg by dressing up like a girl scout!

videos.title: Invasion of the Dads
videos.overview: Timmy's previous wish for a Planet of the Dads backfires when the Dads realize the one thing missing from their lives is Mom, and they come to steal her away from Dad and Timmy! It's up to Timmy, Cosmo (in a magnify glass disguise), Wanda (in ice cube disguise, who was forced to remain in a freezer to prevent from melting), Poof (in a bee disguise), Mark Chang and a rather bumbling "Real Dad" to thwart the Dads and rescue Mom!

videos.title: Take and Fake
videos.overview: Timmy borrows Mark Chang's fake-a-fier in order to attend Trixie's costume party.

videos.title: Cosmo Rules
videos.overview: When Jorgen von Strangle gets the trick-ups (bouts of fairy hiccups that cause bouts of cheesy magician-like parlor magic) he isn't able to enforce Da Rules, so he must pass it on to his closest available relative until he gets better. Unfortunately, his closest available relative is his long-lost cousin Cosmo as his Nana Boom Boom was playing Explosive Bingo and his cousin Leonard Von Strangle was on a trip in the Bahamas.

videos.title: Farm Pit
videos.overview: Mr. Turner has been fired from his job, so he tries to start up a farm instead. Unfortunately, he has no luck at growing anything, so Timmy wishes his father's crops would grow huge. But now Timmy's father has so much success that he wants his family to stay on the farm forever!

videos.title: Crock Talk
videos.overview: After mysterious monster appearences of monsters on Dimmsdale, Crocker starts a webshow to comment it, and asks for viewers to call if they see a monster. Unfortunately, Timmy wishes for them, Dad calls Crocker everynight and he gets a freepass to film the fairies.

videos.title: Food Fight
videos.overview: Tired of his mom's nasty food, Timmy wishes that his mom was the best cook in the world, but when she enters to a cooking competition, the magic wont work and she has to face the challenge alone.

videos.title: Please Don't Feed The Turners
videos.overview: Doug Dimmadome selects the Turners to go on a space mission, but it turns out it was really Dark Laser in disguise with an elaborate plan to take revenge on Timmy and trap the Turners in a space zoo on his Death Ball.

videos.title: Lights Out
videos.overview: After Timmy tells Poof a scary story, the baby's' crying keeps him up all night, so Timmy wishes for no light for twelve hours of day. Little does Timmy know, that when his godparents are kept in the dark for longer than eight hours, they become "Scary Fairies" and turn on their godchild.

videos.title: Dad Overboard
videos.overview: After Mr. Turner gets lost while looking for their hotel and land on a deserted island, he struggles to make a boat to save his family, and to prove his masculinity he doesn't let anyone help him. Timmy wishes for relaxation items, (hammock,Ipod,Club sandwiches,etc).Meanwhile, Poof finds a nuclear bomb in the sand and Cosmo activates it, putting the Turners' life at risk.

videos.title: Old Man And The C-
videos.overview: When Mr. Turner reveals he dropped off school at 5th grade, he attempts to graduate from Dimmsdale Elementary School to make his son proud.

videos.title: Balance of Flour
videos.overview: Centuries ago, the Anti-Fairies and Fairies started an annual bake-off to determine which species gets godchildren, this year, Jorgen von Strangle's recipe is at risk, and Anti-Cosmo and Anti-Wanda are determined to make sure they make Timmy their godchild by stealing the recipe and cheating the fairies out of the competition.

videos.title: Poltergeeks
videos.overview: Timmy has Cosmo, Wanda, and Poof pose as ghosts so that his parents can re-live their glory days as ghostbusters.

videos.title: Beach Blanket Bozos
videos.overview: During a trip to Hawaii, Timmy wishes that his parents were the best surfers ever, but that wish starts a wish limbo, in which they won't stop fighting until only one prevails as best surfer ever in Hawaii.

videos.title: When Losers Attack
videos.overview: Timmy Turner’s enemies collaborate to form the League of Super Evil Revenge Seekers (L.O.S.E.R.S.) in order to annihilate him. When the Fairy-clipse, a rare astronomical event that happens every million years, prevents Cosmo and Wanda from using their magic to save him, Timmy is forced to outwit the L.O.S.E.R.S. himself.

videos.title: Meet the OddParents
videos.overview: Mom and Dad have finally realized the fact that Timmy has fairy godparents! When Timmy's parents discover Cosmo, Wanda, and Poof, Timmy must keep Jorgen from finding out about it; otherwise, he will lose his fairies forever.

videos.title: Fairly OddPet
videos.overview: Timmy adopts a mischievous and magical fairy dog named Sparky. However, owning a fairy dog proves to be a much bigger challenge than Timmy could have ever predicted.

videos.title: Dinklescouts!
videos.overview: Timmy wishes Mr. Dinkleberg would replace Dad as Squirrely Scout leader.

videos.title: I Dream of Cosmo
videos.overview: Cosmo loses his memory and mistakenly thinks he's supposed to grant wishes for Timmy's father.

videos.title: Turner & Pooch
videos.overview: Mr. Crocker realizes that Sparky has magical powers. Eager to use the fairy dog’s powers to fulfill his own wishes, Mr. Crocker hypnotizes Sparky in an attempt to turn him against Timmy.

videos.title: Dumbbell Curve
videos.overview: Crocker grades on a bell curve so Timmy wishes everyone was dumber than him. Unfortunately, a meteor threatens Earth and Timmy’s the only one smart enough to stop it.

videos.title: The Terrible Twosome
videos.overview: Poof is going through the Terrible Twos, and Foop uses this to cause mayhem in Dimmsdale.

videos.title: App Trap
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for the world's coolest smart phone.

videos.title: Force of Nature
videos.overview: Timmy wishes the animals would clean up after themselves.

videos.title: Viral Vidiots
videos.overview: Crocker kidnaps Timmy's mom because he thinks she's a troll who possesses magic.

videos.title: Scary GodCouple
videos.overview: Foop becomes Vicky's anti-fairy godparent and they both terrorize Timmy and the kids of Dimmsdale.

videos.title: School of Crock
videos.overview: Mr. Crocker becomes a teacher at the Fairy Academy; Poof begins to learn how to talk.

videos.title: Cosmonopoly
videos.overview: Timmy, his father and the fairies get stuck in a board game created by Cosmo.

videos.title: Hero Hound
videos.overview: Timmy wishes Sparky would get a chance to be heroic, while Dad thinks he can talk to animals.

videos.title: A Boy and His Dog-Boy
videos.overview: After making a deal with Dad, Crocker becomes best friends with Dinkleberg

videos.title: Crock Blocked
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that Mr. Crocker would disappear, and Mr. Crocker becomes invisible.

videos.title: Finding Emo
videos.overview: To impress a new girl at his school, Timmy wishes that he was several different personalities, one of them being emo.

videos.title: Dust Busters
videos.overview: Fairy Dust has been building up in Timmy's room, so he needs to clear it out before he can make more wishes.

videos.title: The Past and the Furious
videos.overview: When Cosmo and Wanda bring Timmy back through time to meet their former Godchildren, his interactions with them alter the future.

videos.title: Let Sleeper Dogs Lie
videos.overview: Crocker tries to program Sparky as an unwitting sleeper agent in his war against Timmy and the fairies.

videos.title: Cat-Astrophe
videos.overview: Catman mistakes Sparky for his old archenemy Dogman.

videos.title: Jerk of All Trades
videos.overview: Timmy gets Jorgen fired. He helps Jorgen find a new job.

videos.title: Snack Attack
videos.overview: Sparky makes his own magic dog treats. Crocker tries to buy one million of them in order to make a wish

videos.title: Turning into Turner
videos.overview: Using Timmy's DNA, Crocker pretends to be Timmy from the future.

videos.title: The Wand That Got Away
videos.overview: Cosmo loses his wand and Timmy and the gang must help find it.

videos.title: Dimmsdale Tales
videos.overview: When Dad forgets all of the supplies for the Squirrely Scouts camping trip, Timmy tries to smooth things over with scary stories around a campfire.

videos.title: Love at First Bark
videos.overview: Sparky is forbidden from dating Dinkleberg's new dog.

videos.title: Desperate Without Housewives
videos.overview: Timmy wishes all women away to end Mom's constant nagging.

videos.title: Stage Fright
videos.overview: After deciding she wants to be an actress, Vicky forces Timmy to help her get her first role.

videos.title: Gone Flushin
videos.overview: Dad flushes Timmy and the fairies down the toilet.

videos.title: The Bored Identity
videos.overview: Timmy tries to inject excitement into his dad's life by wishing it were an action movie.

videos.title: Country Clubbed
videos.overview: Timmy and his parents get invited to a country club. Cosmo feuds with a gopher. Timmy wishes to be a socialite.

videos.title: Two and a Half Babies
videos.overview: Foop and Poof have to take care of an egg for a school project. Foop breaks it and swaps it with a dangerous one.

videos.title: Anchors Away
videos.overview: Chet Ubetcha quits his job. Dad becomes the new news man. Timmy must get Chet back in order to save the city.

videos.title: Dog Gone
videos.overview: Dad refuses to sell Sparky to his boss so he makes Dad's life miserable at work. Timmy and Sparky hatch a plan.

videos.title: Turner Back Time
videos.overview: Timmy's ancestors get new careers, which leads to Timmy's family to act like rich spoiled brats.

videos.title: Weirdos on a Train
videos.overview: After making a deal with Dad, Crocker becomes best friends with Dinkleberg.

videos.title: Tons of Timmys
videos.overview: Timmy wishes for 5,000 Timmys for the Planet of the Dads.

videos.title: Lame Ducks
videos.overview: When a burglar steals the Turner's house, Timmy's dad starts a neighborhood watch program.

videos.title: A Perfect Nightmare
videos.overview: Timmy tries to win a contest by wishing that he had the perfect family.

videos.title: Fairly Odd Fairy Tales
videos.overview: When Poof has trouble falling asleep, Wanda tries to help by reading him a book of classic fairy tales.

videos.title: Man's Worst Friend
videos.overview: In order to make Timmy and his family miserable, Foop replaces Sparky with the Anti-Sparky. He then decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing all pets with an evil pet. Timmy and his fairies must save Dimmsdale.

videos.title: Fairly Old Parent
videos.overview: Jorgen starts a fairy old person program and assigns Poof to Mrs. Crocker.

videos.title: The Fairy Beginning
videos.overview: When Jorgen discovers that Cosmo never graduated from the Fairy Academy, he threatens to take away his job as a Fairy Godparent. To solve the mystery of what happened, the gang looks through Cosmo's memories of his teenage years.

videos.title: The Big Fairy Share Scare
videos.overview: Timmy Turner has to share his fairies with his new neighbor Chloe.

videos.title: Whittle Me This
videos.overview: Timmy and Chloe go to the retirement home to visit Cat-Man. Cat-Man mistakes Chloe for his old sidekick and takes her on ridiculous hero duties, while Cosmo is stumped on what to give Wanda for their anniversary.

videos.title: Mayor May Not
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that his Dad could be the mayor of Dimmsdale, but all the attention of being the mayor's son could lead to the exposure of Cosmo and Wanda.

videos.title: Girly Squirrely
videos.overview: Timmy goes a little crazy when he hears Chloe is joining the Squirrely Scouts, while a bear records something on a sheet when Timmy's dad does something wrong.

videos.title: Birthday Battle
videos.overview: It's Timmy's birthday and he wants toys from his favorite franchise, the Transmorphers. When his godparents tell him that Chloe's birthday is on the same day as his, they fight over where the celebration should be taking place.

videos.title: The Fair Bears
videos.overview: Chloe wishes that her favorite cartoon characters, The Fair Bears, would come to life, but Timmy and Wanda aren't happy with this wish.

videos.title: A Sash and a Rash
videos.overview: Chloe thinks she has a stress-caused rash and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Dad wants to catch a giant fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.

videos.title: Blue Angel
videos.overview: Chloe's goodness is draining the Anti-Fairy World Wand. Foop disguises himself as a girl to try and break Chloe.

videos.title: Marked Man
videos.overview: Timmy takes Chloe to meet Mark Chang to prove to her that aliens really do exist.

videos.title: Animal Crockers
videos.overview: Chloe wishes that an animal that looks oddly like Mr. Crocker would no longer be endangered.

videos.title: One Flu Over the Crocker's Nest
videos.overview: Timmy, Chloe and the fairies go inside Mr. Crocker to destroy the magical Fairy Flu germs Cosmo sneezed on him.

videos.title: Clark Laser
videos.overview: When Timmy and Chloe save Dark Laser's beloved pet, Flipsie, Dark Laser becomes bound to them as their bodyguard.

videos.title: Married to the Mom
videos.overview: Timmy and Chloe wish up a girlfriend for Mr. Crocker to get him off their backs.

videos.title: Booby Trapped
videos.overview: Cosmo and Wanda spend the night at Chloe's, disguised as Flightless Booby Birds. But when Chloe's parents decide to return the boobies to their natural habitat in the rainforest, Timmy and Chloe have to go and save them.

videos.title: Certifiable Super Sitter
videos.overview: Chloe meets Poof for the first time when he comes home from school on Spring Break. Cosmo and Wanda win a free French Dinner, so Chloe gets to babysit Poof and his friends. Everything goes well until Vicky shows up.

videos.title: Crockin' the House
videos.overview: Mrs. Crocker leaves Mr. Crocker home alone for the first time, so he calls on Timmy to teach him how to have fun.

videos.title: Spring Break-Up
videos.overview: A proposed camping trip leads to a feud between Timmy's and Chloe's parents.

videos.title: Fancy Schmancy
videos.overview: Timmy's dad and Chloe's parents don't allow the children to celebrate their Friends' Day together, due to social differences.

videos.title: Dadlantis
videos.overview: Timmy and Chloe become eco-warriors when they save the underwater city of Atlantis from a dangerous "sea monster."

videos.title: Knitwits
videos.overview: Mr. and Mrs. Turner want to renew their marriage vows on a "knight adventure" cruise, but they end up on knitters cruise instead.

videos.title: Chloe Rules!
videos.overview: Timmy regrets wishing Chloe was the school hall monitor when he sees how seriously she takes the job.

videos.title: Tardy Sauce
videos.overview: Chloe wants to break the attendance record, but Timmy tells her school is canceled and drags her to a taco stand.

videos.title: Nuts and Dangerous
videos.overview: Timmy and his Dad enter a film festival for some father-son bonding, but things get out-of-hand when Dad casts Catman.

videos.title: Cat 'n Mouse
videos.overview: Timmy and Chloe have to help a depressed Catman prove to his girlfriend that he's a real superhero

videos.title: Dimmsdale's Got Talent?
videos.overview: Mr. Bickles hosts a talent show and everyone gets in, but Timmy doesn't have any talent.

videos.title: Which Is Wish
videos.overview: Timmy and Chloe switch places, but when Cosmo loses the wands, they risk being stuck as each other forever.

videos.title: Dimmsdale Daze
videos.overview: Chloe wishes that she could be a parent so that she can go to the Dimmsdale Daze carnival with Timmy.

videos.title: Fairy Con
videos.overview: Mr. Crocker makes clones of Cosmo and Wanda in order to access a fairy convention and swipe the fairies' magic.

videos.title: Chip Off the Old Crock!
videos.overview: Mr. Crocker teaches his nephew to be a FAIRY catcher.

videos.title: The Hungry Games
videos.overview: Timmy wishes that Chloe could have a chance to live out her favorite dystopian movie, but he quickly regrets it when everyone is hungry.

videos.title: Summer Bummer
videos.overview: Chloe gives up her summer for research. This upsets her inner child causing her to make crazy sleep wishes.

videos.title: Return of the L.O.S.E.R.S.
videos.overview: Foop, Dark Laser, and Mr. Crocker find out that Timmy is weak without his fairies and they try to get him while he's weak.

videos.title: Space Ca-Dad
videos.overview: The Squirrely Scouts go to space to plant a flag in uncharted territory and gain special Flying Squirrely Status.

videos.title: Goldie-Crocks and the Three Fair Bears
videos.overview: Yet another Squirrely Scout camping trip goes bad when Mr. Crocker and the Fair Bears show up.

videos.title: Hare Raiser
videos.overview: Despite Timmy's strong warning, Chloe wishes the allegedly "dangerous" class bunny was free.

videos.title: The Kale Patch Caper
videos.overview: Chloe resorts to stealing when Timmy's Dad buys the only Kale Patch Kid she needs to complete her collection.

awards: Won 1 Primetime Emmy. 16 wins & 48 nominations total
